audit.whatIsWrong: The full-layer level chart says Ahri wins all seven stages while the content-layer win[0..6] all say Katarina, and every phases[N].why describes Katarina winning that stage. The page renders two different answers.
audit.why: Emerald+ win rate is 52.79% over 7081 games in Katarina's favour, the packet levelChart is Katarina x7, and each why (dagger pickups out-damaging a single Orb pass, Death Lotus winning the straight all-in) argues for Katarina.
audit.corrected: All seven phases[N].side set to Katarina, matching win[0..6] which already read Katarina. Ratings left as-is; they now read as Katarina-favoured stage scores consistent with the whys.

audit.why: Spikes are correctly placed: level 3 (full Q/W/E dagger strings), level 6 Death Lotus (75/60/45s), first item, and 2+ items. Ahri's counter-spike is Spirit Rush at 140/120/100s, which is mobility rather than a damage race, and the existing spikes[] already say so.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no number at all, and the decisive interaction — Charm being point-click, instant, and therefore a hard cancel on the Death Lotus channel — was never stated in the Don'ts or tradeBad. The Orb of Deception return dealing true damage was absent everywhere.
audit.why: Riot's text for Charm: it 'instantly stop[s] movement abilities', so it stops Shunpo mid-dash and, as hard CC, interrupts Katarina's R (kit flags R as 'interruptible — any CC cancels it'). Charm is 12s flat at every rank with 975 range. Orb of Deception deals true damage on the way back, so MR does not blunt it.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns field now carries Charm 12s/975 range and Orb 7s; tradeBad, dontsFull[2].d and breakdown.late state the cancel and the true-damage interaction.

audit.why: 52.79% over 7081 games is already the figure the page implies.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing said that Orb of Deception's return pass is true damage, which invalidates the usual 'buy MR into a mage' instinct.
audit.why: Kit flag trueDamage on Ahri Q plus the missing-interaction rule 'resistances-invalidated'.
